summary:
Our project aims to develop the objective of our challenge through a narrative and illustrative approach by creating a comic. To achieve this, we have drawn on both the resources provided by the challenge itself and research conducted using information from various sources.

However, we did not want to limit ourselves to simply collecting information or presenting events. We aim to bring attention to things that have gradually been forgotten over time. We want to revive, bring to life, inform, and spark curiosity about projects that once represented major technological advancements: spacecraft, robots, modules, and other developments that, although they may no longer have a place in today's world, still have stories worth telling.

This project is not aimed exclusively at younger audiences. It is also intended for space exploration enthusiasts, those who still remember and take an interest in these developments, and those who are curious to discover what once existed but never had the opportunity to learn about it.

We want our comic to be a gateway to new experiences, a space where history, imagination, and knowledge come together. We believe that even ideas left behind still have something to teach us, and that forgotten stories can become an inspiration for building our future.
details:
Our comic uses illustrations and dialogue. The goal is to provide more information about the teams that are working or have worked on Mars.

This project provides information about the rovers and modules we chose to use.

In creating it, we used AI to generate images, which form the basis of this project.

It is creative in various ways, from the development process to how we decided to incorporate the information (dialogues between the characters), the personification of the machines, and the presentation style.

We took into account the years each spacecraft landed on Mars, the distance between them, and the tools each one carried.
